rows.title: General Updates
rows.summary: We are pleased to inform you that the Hon'ble NCLT, Ahmedabad Bench - 1, vide its Order pronounced on October 12, 2026, has rectified the Appointed Date of the Scheme from October 01, 2023 to April 01, 2026.
